@Bettina, I haven't set up the weekly digest yet. The scheduler refused to open, because the gateway needs credentials it doesn't have. Nothing is scheduled, so no digest will post on Monday until that's fixed. Once the scheduler works, I can set up the Monday 08:00 post in #coastal-team with the previous week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items.

Two things I'd build in when I set it up:
- #coastal-random has the same members as #coastal-team (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so pulling from it doesn't expose anything new.
- The digest will leave out money terms such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values and invoice amounts. Those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner, so the open customer items will cover status and dates, not figures.
